name: Osananajimi to Namaiki Gimai ~Bloomer to Mizugi no Yuuwaku~
original_name: 幼馴染と生意気義妹 ～ブルマと水着の誘惑～
source:
The world is full of choices.
Right or left, front or back?
Big breasts or small breasts?
We are constantly forced to make such choices.

Kurami Jun is confessed to by his childhood friend and his step-sister.
Extremely indecisive, he is unable to choose which one to date.

So the two try every trick in the book to win Jun over.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1309692]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
世界充满了选择。
左还是右，前还是后？
大胸还是小胸？
我们不断被迫做出这样的选择。

克拉米纯被他的儿时好友和继妹告白。
他极其优柔寡断，无法选择要和哪一个约会。

于是两人想尽一切办法来赢得Jun的芳心。

[来自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1309692]Getchu[/url]]
